description: Fixed premises with daily cash and no capacity to relocate are the standard targets, along with transport on fixed routes.
energy_note: A route you cannot change is a route they can price.

description: Agricultural export crops with high value and a fixed growing location - limes and avocados - have been taxed at the orchard, a documented pattern in Michoacán.
energy_note: The tree cannot be moved, so the grower pays.

aspect: Closing the business is the common outcome
description: Where the levy exceeds the margin, the shop shuts - which removes the household income and hands the trade to whoever remains.
Highway cargo theft and driver extortion make long-distance trucking - an overwhelmingly male trade - a job with a violence premium built into it.
energy_note: Paid extra for the stretch after dark.

description: Nineteen years. He sells the mill to a man from Celaya for less than it is worth and tells the regulars he is retiring. He is fifty-one. The shop reopens in five weeks under someone else, selling the same tortillas, and nobody asks him about it.
energy_note: Reopened in five weeks by somebody else.
